reference.sources.summary: About these kanji study sets & data sources
reference.sources.overview: These are unofficial, JLPT-aligned community study sets—not a list of kanji required by the exam. N5 is introductory; N1 is advanced. The complete set contains 2,211 kanji. Dictionary glosses are not context-specific translations. Readings in the reference are dictionary metadata, not automatic answers.
